name: science-skill
description: Skills that counter known failure modes of AI-assisted research: paper-polish (calibrated, exemplar-driven abstract/intro rewriting), number-audit (trace and recompute every number), cite-verify (bibliography metadata and claim support), novelty-audit (falsification-oriented prior-work search), mock-review (isolated, pinned, verified mock refereeing), dead-end-ledger (honest research progress ledger).
